import type { ValueKind } from "./types.js";

/**
 * Display metadata for every field the UI can render, keyed by a dotted
 * path into InfrastructureInfo (e.g. "platform.servingNode"). Keeping this
 * separate from the parsers means the UI never has to know which provider
 * produced a value, only how to label and badge it honestly.
 */
export const FIELD_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  "cdn.provider": "Provider",
  "cdn.rayId": "Ray ID",
  "cdn.edgeLocation": "PoP (edge location)",
  "cdn.cacheStatus": "Cache",
  "cdn.requestId": "CDN request ID",

  "platform.provider": "Platform",
  "platform.requestId": "Request ID",
  "platform.servingNode": "Serving node identifier",
  "platform.datacenters": "Datacenter",

  "timing.processing": "Processing",
  "timing.database": "Database",
  "timing.asyncDatabase": "Async DB",
  "timing.render": "Render",
  "timing.compression": "Compression",

  "serverTimingExtras.edge": "Edge",
  "serverTimingExtras.country": "Country",
  "serverTimingExtras.asn": "ASN",
  "serverTimingExtras.theme": "Theme",
  "serverTimingExtras.pageType": "Page type",
};

export const FIELD_KIND: Record<string, ValueKind> = {
  "cdn.provider": "inferred",
  "cdn.rayId": "observed",
  "cdn.edgeLocation": "parsed",
  "cdn.cacheStatus": "observed",
  "cdn.requestId": "observed",

  "platform.provider": "inferred",
  "platform.requestId": "observed",
  "platform.servingNode": "observed",
  "platform.datacenters": "parsed",

  "timing.processing": "parsed",
  "timing.database": "parsed",
  "timing.asyncDatabase": "parsed",
  "timing.render": "parsed",
  "timing.compression": "parsed",

  "serverTimingExtras.edge": "observed",
  "serverTimingExtras.country": "observed",
  "serverTimingExtras.asn": "observed",
  "serverTimingExtras.theme": "observed",
  "serverTimingExtras.pageType": "observed",
};

export function fieldLabel(path: string): string {
  return FIELD_LABELS[path] ?? path;
}

export function fieldKind(path: string): ValueKind {
  return FIELD_KIND[path] ?? "observed";
}
